reports.title: Deadly Devotion: The Kirtland Cult Murders
reports.description:
It’s considered one of the most high-profile crimes in Ohio. A family of five, murdered by the leader of a cult, a man who called himself a prophet, with the help of his followers. 

Each Avery family member was shot one by one by Jeffrey Lundgren, who had convinced a group of followers that he had been chosen by God and that the Avery family had to be sacrificed. 

On the morning of January 4, 1990, investigators began digging up the dirt floor of a red barn on a 15-acre farm on Euclid Chardon Road in Kirtland, Ohio. They suspected what they would find. They were not prepared for what it was like to find it. 

Buried beneath that barn floor, covered with lime and stacked together in a common grave — were the bodies of Dennis and Cheryl Avery and their three daughters: Trina, 15; Rebecca, 13; and Karen, 7. They had been murdered nine months earlier, in April of 1989. 

Thirty-seven years have now passed since their murders. Twenty years have passed since the state of Ohio executed Jeffrey Lundgren for his crimes. 19 Investigates is giving you a look at the story from a different perspective, decades later. This documentary is the story of how it happened. How a group of ordinary people got swept up in a cult, brain-washed into believing they had to go forward with Lundgren’s horrifying plans. 

19 Investigates spoke with former cult members, including Jeffrey Lundgren’s former right hand. 

We also spoke with a detective who responded to the scene and will never forget it. And we delve into the power of cults with an expert who says cults can be just as dangerous today, even if they don’t end with extreme violence like in Kirtland. 

We show you the confession tapes, the secret recordings, and how an investigation into the cult before the murders wasn’t enough to prevent it. 

The people who were there will never forget. All of these years later, they’re telling their story to warn others about the dangers of mind control and the heavy weight they will carry forever.
